### part(a)

我们假设模型为
$$Y=2.5+3.8X_1^2+2.3X_2^{0.5}+\varepsilon$$
并生成100个随机数。

```{r part a}
library(ISLR)
library(leaps)   
library(mgcv)    
library(ggplot2)  
library(dplyr)    
library(caret) 

# (a) 生成数据
set.seed(456) 

n <- 100
X1 <- runif(n, -2, 2)
X2 <- rnorm(n, mean = 1, sd = 0.5)  
epsilon <- rnorm(n, sd = 8)  
Y <- 2.5 + 3.8 * X1 ** 2 + 2.3 * X2 ** 0.5 + epsilon
```

### part(b-e)

```{r part b-e}

# (b) 初始化β2
beta2 <- 1.0 

results <- matrix(NA, nrow = 12, ncol = 3) 
colnames(results) <- c("beta0", "beta1", "beta2")

# (e) 迭代过程 
for (i in 1:12) {  
  # 先固定β2，更新β1
  a <- Y - beta2 * X2
  model_c <- lm(a ~ X1)
  beta1 <- coef(model_c)[2]
  beta0_temp <- coef(model_c)[1]
  
  # 再固定β1，更新β2
  a <- Y - beta1 * X1
  model_d <- lm(a ~ X2)
  beta2 <- coef(model_d)[2]
  beta0 <- coef(model_d)[1]

  results[i, ] <- c(beta0, beta1, beta2)
}
```

### part(f)
```{r part f}
# (f) 结果分析
# iteration map - 改变图形样式
plot(1:12, results[, "beta0"], type = "b", col = "darkred", pch = 16,
     ylim = range(results), xlab = "迭代次数", ylab = "系数估计",
     main = "坐标下降法参数收敛过程")
lines(1:12, results[, "beta1"], type = "b", col = "navy", pch = 16)
lines(1:12, results[, "beta2"], type = "b", col = "darkgreen", pch = 16)
legend("topright", legend = c("β0", "β1", "β2"), 
       col = c("darkred", "navy", "darkgreen"), lty = 1, pch = 16)

mlr_model <- lm(Y ~ X1 + X2)
mlr_coef <- coef(mlr_model)

abline(h = mlr_coef[1], col = "darkred", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
abline(h = mlr_coef[2], col = "navy", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)
abline(h = mlr_coef[3], col = "darkgreen", lty = 2, lwd = 1.5)

legend("bottomright", legend = "虚线: 多元线性回归基准", 
       lty = 2, lwd = 1.5, bty = "n")

cat("多元线性回归结果:\n")
print(mlr_coef)

cat("\n坐标下降法最终结果:\n")
cat("β0 =", round(results[12, "beta0"], 4), "\n")
cat("β1 =", round(results[12, "beta1"], 4), "\n")
cat("β2 =", round(results[12, "beta2"], 4), "\n")
```

### part(g)
```{r part g}
# (g) 迭代次数
differences <- apply(results, 1, function(x) mean(abs(x - mlr_coef)))

threshold <- 0.005  
converged_iter <- which(differences < threshold)[1]

if (!is.na(converged_iter)) {
  cat(sprintf("\n达到良好近似所需的迭代次数: %d (平均绝对差异 < %.4f)\n", 
              converged_iter, threshold))
} else {
  cat(sprintf("\n在%d次迭代内未达到平均绝对差异 < %.4f的阈值\n", 
              12, threshold))
  min_diff_iter <- which.min(differences)
  cat(sprintf("最小差异出现在第%d次迭代，差异值为: %.6f\n", 
              min_diff_iter, differences[min_diff_iter]))
}

plot(1:12, differences, type = "b", col = "purple", pch = 17,
     xlab = "迭代次数", ylab = "平均绝对差异",
     main = "收敛情况分析")
abline(h = threshold, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2)
legend("topright", legend = paste("阈值 =", threshold), 
       col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 2, bty = "n")
